caveats: Hosts: macOS 14+, Linux on X11 or Wayland (tested on GNOME), or Windows 10/11 (experimental); any Paseo client can view.
The helper builds on first use: needs Xcode tools on macOS, or a C compiler and dev packages on Linux; Windows needs nothing.
macOS needs Screen Recording and Accessibility granted once; Wayland asks for approval in a desktop dialog.
Frames are polled JPEGs at roughly 5 to 15 fps, so it is not smooth video.
Any paired client can see and control the host; Pause remote control stops input from every viewer.
A sleeping host goes offline with Paseo, so set it not to sleep while plugged in.
